title: Old boot path can initialize or migrate the primary store before the coordination store refuses an unsupported (one-way) schema
outcome: Before any one-way coordination-store schema is activated, a host (including an older binary on rollback) cannot change the primary store when the paired coordination store is at a schema it does not support: the coordination check refuses before any primary initialization or migration, or a guard proves no primary mutation happens.
acceptance: The boot path checks the coordination store's schema version (or reader floor) before it initializes or migrates the primary store, or an equivalent guard prevents any primary-store mutation when the coordination store is unsupported.
A test with disposable paired stores shows that an unsupported coordination schema leaves the primary store byte-for-byte unchanged and the host refuses to start with a typed error.
The activation item for the a15b compact-retention successor schema lists this item as a prerequisite.
